parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task.

parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description: The precheck task ID. You can call the **DescribePreCheckStatus** operation to query the task ID.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the DTS instance. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

parameters.name: Skip
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to skip the precheck item. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false**

parameters.name: SkipPreCheckItems
parameters.description:
The shortened name of the precheck item. Valid values:

*   **\["CHECK_SAME_OBJ"]**: object name conflict.
*   **\["CHECK_SAME_USER"]**: username conflict.
*   **\["CHECK_SRC"]**: source database version.
*   **\["CHECK_TOPOLOGY"]**: topology. For more information about the topologies supported by Data Transmission Service (DTS), see [Synchronization topologies](~~124115~~).
*   **\["CHECK_SERVER_ID"]**: the server ID of the source database.
*   **\["CHECK_DEST_TABLE_EMPTY"]**: existence of objects in the destination database.

> Separate multiple item names with commas (,). Example: **\["CHECK_SRC","CHECK_SAME_OBJ"]**.

parameters.name: SkipPreCheckNames
parameters.description:
The precheck item name. This parameter corresponds to **SkipPreCheckItems**. Valid values:

*   **\["CHECK_SAME_OBJ_DETAIL"]**: object name conflict.
*   **\["CHECK_SAME_USER_DETAIL"]**: username conflict.
*   **\["CHECK_SRC_DETAIL"]**: source database version.
*   **\["CHECK_TOPOLOGY_DETAIL"]**: topology. For more information about the topologies supported by DTS, see [Synchronization topologies](~~124115~~).
*   **\["CHECK_SERVER_ID_DETAIL"]**: the server ID of the source database.
*   **\["CHECK_DEST_TABLE_EMPTY_DETAIL"]**: empty tables in the destination database.

> Separate multiple item names with commas (,). Example: **\["CHECK_SRC_DETAIL","CHECK_SAME_OBJ_DETAIL"]**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts skip-pre-check --job-id b4my3zg929a0000 --skip true --skip-pre-check-items CHECK_SAME_OBJ --skip-pre-check-names CHECK_SAME_OBJ_DETAIL --dts-job-id c7412z57g8k0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts SkipPreCheck --region cn-hangzhou --DtsJobId c7412z57g8k0000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --Skip true --SkipPreCheckNames CHECK_SAME_OBJ_DETAIL --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --SkipPreCheckItems CHECK_SAME_OBJ --JobId b4my3zg929a0000
